settings.about.license: SonosDesk is an independent open-source project (MIT license). No telemetry is sent.
settings.about.now_playing_text: Track information comes from the speaker or from the ICY metadata of the respective radio stream.
settings.about.radio_text: The station list, stream addresses and station logos come from the free community directory
settings.about.radio_text_after: . The data is retrieved at runtime via the public API and is not passed on. Rights to station names, logos and programs belong to the respective radio stations.
settings.about.software_text: .NET, WPF and Microsoft.Extensions (MIT), CommunityToolkit.Mvvm (MIT). Icons: Segoe Fluent Icons (Windows). Details in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md in the source code.
settings.about.sonos_text: “Sonos” and the associated logos are trademarks of Sonos, Inc. © Sonos, Inc. All rights reserved. SonosDesk is not an official Sonos product and is neither endorsed nor reviewed by Sonos, Inc. Control works through the speakers' local UPnP interfaces or the public

settings.control_api.header: Set up the Sonos Control API (experimental)
settings.control_api.intro: Requires your own integration in the Sonos developer portal (client key, client secret and a registered HTTPS redirect URI). After signing in in the browser, paste the full URL you were redirected to here. The secret and tokens are stored encrypted with Windows DPAPI.

settings.network.interval_hint: How often to search in the background for new or missing devices.
settings.network.manual_addresses_hint: One IP address per line (e.g. 192.168.1.20). Useful when multicast is blocked by a VPN, guest Wi-Fi or firewall. One player is enough – other rooms are found via the group information. Required: UDP 1900 (discovery) and TCP 1400 (control) on the local network.
settings.network.stream_metadata: For radio, read the current track directly from the stream
settings.network.stream_metadata_hint: If the speaker only reports the station name, SonosDesk reads the track from the stream's ICY metadata (short connection every 20 s, internet addresses only).
